items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Did you have Joe Springer in your band also? Yeah, he was a good player --- quiet fella. --- He stayed with me a long time.

ctx.x: . . . . Prestige would hire sidemen for me, a lot of them did it . . . . I guess they was lookin' for names, you know.
What kind of songs did you play with your own band when you started?
